hypothesis: A model that encodes role types in its 576-byte native state and learns 16 role compatibility weights can distinguish same-graph/same-query necessary-role swaps and generalize to new motif families and role-alphabet permutations, unlike frozen F9's role-blind system.

design.positive_negative_pair: same graph and query, exactly one necessary role type changes, distractor four-step route retained
design.resident_state_format: 144 float32 (576B): 12 packed source-target words, 12 role words (48B), 120 reserved floats; transition scores recomputed by frozen learned entity similarity
design.query_metadata: 4 role IDs (4B) plus 2 graph endpoint IDs (4B), explicitly outside resident state
design.candidate: Y-F6 frozen 22-param learned comparator/composer plus 16 trainable role compatibility logits; no coded relation equality or OR reachability in candidate inference
design.optimization: 170 Adam steps learning ONLY 16 role logits from paired end-to-end task BCE, initial logits all zero, lr .1, torch seed 1048
controls: identical model with all role logits untrained
identical-graph paired label flip and global role renaming
